gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Noto Sans Ugaritic follows in a sans-serif with hardly any step between its small and tall letters, so a long passage glides along without bumps.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-vai: Loud, loose and full of nerve: Paprika spreads its letters out and lets its lowercase stand tall like capitals. Noto Sans Vai holds words together as solid blocks, so the heading does the shouting and the sans-serif does the steady talking.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Paprika puts its lowercase at capital height and leaves generous gaps between letters, which gives it real presence. Noto Sans Vithkuqi does the opposite job, a plain sans with open throats and a minimal step up to the capitals, built for quiet reading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Big, brash and spaced out, Paprika fills each line with lowercase that behaves like capitals and counters cut open wide. Noto Sans Wancho then reads as a heavy, chalky sans-serif, dense but easy to follow.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-onest: Paprika's lowercase swells to capital size and its curves thicken and thin, giving every word a commanding, hand-cut look. Onest keeps a plain sans line with short ascenders and big bowls.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-orienta: Paprika spaces its letters far apart and fills the line with lowercase that behaves like capitals, which feels loud and expressive. Orienta, a sans-serif, keeps little height difference between cases.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-oxygen: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, spaced out and hollow-bellied, all swagger. Oxygen, a sans-serif whose curves never close back on themselves, sits beneath it with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so the two feel like loud and quiet cousins.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans reads like bent wire, one stroke thickness throughout, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp even when shrunk. A long passage in it moves briskly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme reads as rounded and open, with stubby ascenders and descenders tucked beside a big x-height. Pathway Extreme keeps a long passage tidy and sociable, a sans that lets Paprika's loud heading stay the only show-off.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear brings a lofty x-height and letter mouths pried open like oyster shells, a sans that looks modern and approachable. Paprika above it is the showman, its spaced-out capital-like lowercase commanding attention, while Preahvihear carries the text underneath.
